import re
import sys

values = {}

assignment = re.compile(r"^\s*(\w+)\s*<-\s*(.*?)\s*;\s*$")
addition = re.compile(r"\(\s*(\w+)\s*\+\s*(\d+)\s*\)\s*mod\s*(\d+)")

for line in sys.stdin:
    match = assignment.match(line)
    if not match:
        continue

    name, expression = match.groups()
    expression = expression.strip()

    operation = addition.fullmatch(expression)
    if operation:
        variable, increment, modulus = operation.groups()
        values[name] = (values[variable] + int(increment)) % int(modulus)
    else:
        values[name] = int(expression)

names = ("a", "b", "c", "d", "e", "f", "g", "h", "TMP")
print("; ".join(f"{name} ?= {values[name]}" for name in names) + ";")
